title: Cheirinho de papinha
purpose: Mesmo conceito de quatro raridades, agora com o Tiro bebê. Orelhas caídas, pelagem preta/castanha, pose, papinha e tigela azul preservadas.

variants.label: Comum
variants.detail: COMMON / LEVEL 1: a beautifully drawn but simple everyday first-meal memory. Simplify backdrop: broad clean wall colors, plain rug with few simple shapes, plant leaves as a few larger shapes, softer simplified floor grain and window light. Puppy remains lovingly drawn and cute but use restrained fur highlights. Matte natural warm cream/tan/navy palette, soft even light, low-to-medium environmental detail. No glitter, sparkles, floating magic particles, bloom, foil or iridescence. Not dull or unfinished, simply calm and uncluttered.
variants.prompt: Edit the supplied illustration into ONE rarity variation of Tiro Adventure's existing memory 'Cheirinho de papinha'. This is an edit of the SAME PHOTO. Preserve precisely the baby Yorkshire puppy identity: very small compact body, big expressive brown eyes, fluffy BLACK crown and back, tan/golden eyebrows muzzle chest paws, TWO FLOPPY ears. Do NOT age him, do not stand his ears upright, do not change coat into adult blue/gold. LOCK composition and story: same puppy sitting centrally, same pose/expression, tiny dab of puppy mash on right side of muzzle, same big BLUE mash bowl at lower right, little red bowl at lower left, warm wooden floor, round red/cream rug behind, sunlit left window, terracotta plant on right, framed dog picture behind. Keep these objects and their locations. Same refined 2D animated storybook drawing, dark delicate outlines, layered fur tufts and cel shading. Square full-bleed artwork. No border, no labels, no words or UI, no humans or extra animals. Keep puppy's face and food clearly visible. Rarity changes the scene's DETAIL, LIGHTING and PRINT FINISH, never puppy age or the meaning of the memory. COMMON / LEVEL 1: a beautifully drawn but simple everyday first-meal memory. variants.label: Rara

Visibly more ornate setting and finer details than shiny, while same exact first-meal scene.

variants.label: Holográfica
variants.detail: HOLOGRAPHIC / LEVEL 4: the premium collectible PRINT FINISH of this SAME baby first-meal illustration. Keep puppy, mash dab, blue bowl, red bowl, rug, window and plant all in same places and preserve black-and-tan puppy coloring. Add unmistakable yet elegant iridescent HOLOGRAPHIC FOIL sweeps and prismatic cyan/violet/pink/gold reflective bands across the floor, rug, blue bowl, background wall and window light; reflective microfoil flecks and a few precise four-point rainbow glints. Richly detailed environment, pearl sheen and fine colored rim highlights on fur, but puppy's face stays clearly visible and naturally black-and-tan, not recolored rainbow. Retain warm daytime home atmosphere instead of changing to a fantasy night scene. Full bleed holographic art without a card border or writing, not just extra yellow brightness.
